description: CoinLoader/BotAppStore: List the bots and bundles for sale on BotAppStore and CoinLoader (or the SOL-only wattcoin.org bots with site=wattcoin). Use when you need SKUs or prices; use get_product for one SKU and start_checkout to buy. No auth needed; read-only, live, creates no order. Returns JSON with sku, name, USD price, payment methods, summary and page URL for live, purchasable items only.

site.description: Store: botappstore, coinloader, or wattcoin (wattcoin.org bots, SOL only). Omit to list BotAppStore and CoinLoader together

storefront.description: Alias of site for botappstore or coinloader; site wins if both are given
